Sofia / Rishi — available Thu Jun 10 morning PT (09:00 PT) and can join the 13:00 PT slot as backup. Quick notes for the workshop and capacity:

1) Hosted vs Dedicated recommendation
- For a 2-week POC with light load testing, start on Hosted trial with a temporary quota bump. Hosted gives fastest onboarding and we can instrument token-level telemetry immediately.
- If BlueArc intends to run sustained heavy load or needs data isolation, recommend Dedicated (reserved GPU) — costlier but predictable throughput and lower tail latency. We can run a short Dedicated eval but that requires procurement lead time.

2) Quota bump proposal for load test
- Baseline trial token rate: 50k tokens/min (default)
- Proposed temporary bump for load test: 200k tokens/min for 30 minutes (to simulate 3 concurrent clients @ ~1k tokens/request, 60 reqs/min each).
- Also request a per-user concurrent stream cap increase to 6 to avoid early connection drops.

3) Prework checklist for BlueArc
- Share representative prompt set (redacted) and target response length distribution
- Tell us expected peak concurrent users and average sessions/minute
- Confirm whether PII will appear in prompts (affects telemetry/audit)

4) Load-test steps (for the session)
- Warm up with representative prompts for 5–10 minutes
- Run three parallel client threads over 20 minutes ramping to peak
- Collect token/min, p50/p95/p99 latency, and failure rates

I can produce a short capacity-estimate spreadsheet (capacity-estimate.xlsx) and Marissa can coordinate a temporary quota request once BlueArc confirms the slot.

—Dev
Dev Patel
